candidate.check: concurrently -n lint,types,api-report "pnpm run check:lint-ts" "pnpm run check:typecheck" "pnpm run check:api-report"
candidate.test: concurrently -n vitest,tsd "pnpm run test:ts" "pnpm run test:types"
candidate.uplevel-api-reports: mkdir -p ../../api-report-combined ../../api-docs-temp && cp api-report/sh-ast.api.md api-report/sh-ast-analyze.api.md ../../api-report-combined/ && cp temp/sh-ast.api.json temp/sh-ast-analyze.api.json ../../api-docs-temp/
